summary: A subquery can provide a list to filter with. IN, NOT IN, and EXISTS are the main tools.
points: WHERE id IN (SELECT ...) keeps rows found in the list.
NOT IN returns nothing if the list contains a NULL, because every comparison becomes unknown.
Protect NOT IN by filtering NULLs inside the subquery.
EXISTS checks whether a subquery finds any row, and NULLs don't affect it.

example.explanation: This finds employees who manage no one. Without the IS NOT NULL filter, it would return nothing.
